analyst.summary: Sudarshan Chemical Industries is a global pigments manufacturer that appears to have gone through a large, transformative acquisition - quarterly sales roughly quadrupled in the last year and promoter ownership was diluted from over 50% historically to about 8% today, most likely to help fund or refinance the deal. Reported growth numbers are therefore not a clean read on the underlying business, and current profitability (return on equity near zero) has not yet caught up with the much larger revenue base. We are holding this per house rules but flagging it for a closer look given how much has changed in a short period.
